introduction: Washington ABD provides cash and disability-application support to eligible adults. DSHS conducts financial and medical assessments.
description: Washington ABD provides cash and disability-application support to eligible adults. DSHS conducts financial and medical assessments.

sections.who: Applicants must live in Washington, meet income, resource and status rules, and be 65 or older, blind, or an adult with a condition preventing work for at least 12 consecutive months.
sections.get: Assistance includes a monthly grant, an HEN referral and help pursuing SSI or SSDI.
sections.docs:
• Income, resources and identity records.
  • Medical evidence requested by the social worker.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use Washington Connection, a Community Services Office or 877-501-2233.

  2. Complete the interview

    Financial interviews are available by phone or in person, weekdays 8 a.m.–2 p.m.

  3. Complete medical review

    If financially eligible, work with the assigned social worker.
sections.after: Follow SSI application and case-management requests. ABD is not available to someone whose spouse or self already receives SSI.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DSHS ABD. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does ABD approve federal disability benefits?
No. It helps with the separate federal application.
Disability applicants undergo medical eligibility review.
Ask the HEN provider about available support.
Contact a Community Services Office or phone intake.
